---
title: "Stationary calibration and Markov augmentation for Adam-type adaptive MCMC"
author:
  - name: "Jordan Simbananiye"
    affiliations:
      - name: "University College London (UCL) - CCMI CDT"
date: last-modified
abstract: |
  Adam-type adaptation normalises fixed-gain first- and second-moment memories.
  Under Markov innovations, its stationary calibration field contains a
  covariance correction at Robbins--Monro roots. We construct the stationary
  augmented process and lift geometric Wasserstein contraction from its
  Markov driver. Weighted kernel perturbations yield regularity of the
  invariant law and a log-Lipschitz parameter estimate for the augmented
  Poisson solution. With quadratic drift, bounded adaptation increments
  and standard gain conditions, the resulting martingale decomposition gives
  ODE tracking of the stationary Adam field. The abstract results apply to
  contractive-memory Markov recursions; sampler-specific assumptions are
  identified separately.
---
